score_caveat: Weighted sum is 7.142 (hook 1.35, story 1.56, picture 1.46, place 0.84, craft 0.952, voice 0.98). I did not round it up and it clears the bar by a small margin. The voice axis (7.0) rests on provider text and measured caption boundaries, not on listening. If a reviewer with audio access scored voice at 5.0 the sum would fall under the bar, so that axis is the most fragile input.
one_sentence_fix: In ClinicAnswerFilm.tsx and ClinicSupport.tsx reframe the s6 shot (29.4 to 33.3 s) so the Answer card and its Accuracy slot sit fully inside the frame instead of running off the right edge over empty paper, remove the clipped leftover Announced and Sep tag fragments from the s3, s5, s6 and s8 framings (they collide with the caption box at 27.2 to 29.2 s), trim the near-static hold at 7.0 to 10.5 s in s2, and put the Gulf window plate behind the s5, s6 and s8 shots, then re-render and re-align captions.

source.observed: claims.json c1 to c5 and c8 are VERIFIED with verbatim UTMB release quotes (c1 dateline September 22, 2026, c2 live in March, c3 standard credentials, c4 citations to medical literature, clinical guidelines and other authoritative sources, c5 more than half, c8 will continue evaluating). The no-accuracy or no-patient-care-measure statement rests on the validator's absence search in c8's scope_note, since its quote supports only the continue-evaluating half.

comprehension.observed: Reconstructed from the image sequence with captions in view: hands type a question and the card goes into the OpenEvidence tool, an answer returns with three source-type cards, tags give the announcement and March go-live, sign-in opens a lock, the cards are labelled medical literature, clinical guidelines and other sources, a clinician-token share passes Half, UTMB's own report is tagged, Accuracy and Patient care read Not in release beside an empty Accuracy ring, and an evaluating tag closes. No audio was heard, so comprehension is established from pictures only.

technical_audio.observed: I did not hear the audio and cannot support a pass. The provider receipt claims clean, intelligible narration with unobtrusive music and no distortion, and the board says captions are silence-anchored, but a text claim or timing record can't establish an audible performance. This is a limit of my access, not an observed audio defect.

attention_review.hook_observed: At 0.0 s hands are already typing and a Question card grows lines (0.0 to 0.4 s). By 1.0 s the card enters the OpenEvidence tool and the camera pans to it. A new answer card emerges at about 3.0 s and drops to the desk, and citation cards fan and tuck into Sources at 4.4 to 4.8 s.
attention_review.continuity_observed: The same teal-tab clipboard, OpenEvidence tool, Answer card (Sources filled, Accuracy dashed and empty) and tag style recur across the cuts at 5.3, 12.0, 16.8, 22.0, 29.4, 33.4, 36.8, 39.0 and 41.6 s. At the s2 to s3 cut the Live since March tag and lock carry over. The s3 to s4 cut (16.8 s) lands on a bare Answer card with no desk, which the card's identity bridges. The s4 to s5 cut moves to a new subject (the clinician-token share) with the tool visible by 24.4 s.
attention_review.pacing_observed: Visible developments: question to tool 0.0 to 1.4 s, answer and citations 3.0 to 4.8 s, Announced tag 6.4 to 6.8 s, Live since March 10.5 to 10.8 s, credentials and lock 12.4 to 14.4 s, plain-language question 15.2 to 16.6 s, citations fan and are labelled 17.0 to 21.8 s, tokens light and bar passes Half 22.4 to 24.0 s, decision-support tag 25.0 to 25.4 s, own-report tag 27.6 to 28.4 s, Accuracy and Patient care tags 30.2 to 32.0 s, thread to Sources 34.0 to 34.8 s, Accuracy slot pulse 37.0 to 38.4 s, evaluation tag 39.4 to 39.8 s, closing view and ring pulse 41.6 to 42.8 s. Static stretches are about 3.5 s in s2 (7.0 to 10.5 s), 1.9 s in s7 (34.8 to 36.7 s) and 1.2 s at the end of s8 (42.8 to 44.0 s). Nothing exceeds 5 s. The 5 s credit card is static after a 0.4 s fade. The tool hold at 1.4 to 3.0 s is motivated by the question being processed. Nothing arrives too fast to follow in the samples.
attention_review.comprehension_observed: After one viewing of the pictures the viewer can follow question, sourced answer, dated announcement and go-live, ordinary sign-in, source types, adoption share, own-report attribution, missing accuracy and patient-care measures, and UTMB's continued evaluation. The false inference that a citation proves correctness is answered by the empty Accuracy ring. Overload risk is low except in s6, where the card is cropped and the tags are the sole carrier.
attention_review.remembered_image: The Answer card with its filled Sources slot beside the empty dashed Accuracy ring and two Not in release tags (s6 31.8 s, s8 42 to 44 s), because it states in one picture what came back and what is unpublished.
attention_review.weakest_interval: s6, 29.4 to 33.4 s: the cut lands on an Answer card clipped by the right edge in an otherwise empty frame, the Accuracy slot leaves frame at 31.4 s and the tags are the only carrier. Repair: reframe so the whole card and the Accuracy slot sit inside the frame beside the tags.
attention_review.audio_basis: No direct listening. Only the provider receipt's text claims and the board's measured caption boundaries were available.

first_frame.observed: Image sequence 0.0 to 1.4 s: hands at a keyboard with a Question card whose text lines grow, an open lock behind it, then the card travels into the OpenEvidence tool as the camera pans. The subject and action read with captions covered.

visual_progression.observed: Each scene adds a new subject or state: question and answer, dated tags, sign-in and lock, source-type cards, clinician share, own-report tag, Not in release tags, thread and empty Accuracy ring, evaluation tag. Judged from 5 fps samples, not from playback.

shot_variety.observed: Wide desk, medium chart-and-tool, close credential desk, detail on cards, close share board, wide and extreme-close answer card across the sequence. The s4, s6 to s8 desk and answer-card views are similar but differ in framing and subject emphasis.

performed_turn.observed: Accuracy and Patient care tags clip onto the answer at 30.2 to 30.8 s and their Not in release lines fade in at 31.4 to 32.0 s. The card is clipped at the right edge and the Accuracy slot is out of frame from 31.4 s.

pace.observed: A visible development about every 1 to 3 s, longest near-static stretches about 3.5 s (7.0 to 10.5 s) and 1.9 s (34.8 to 36.7 s). Motion smoothness between samples is unverified.

The ring pulses at 42.2 to 42.8 s then the picture holds still to 44.0 s. It answers the opening question.
